# Minimal builder configuration. SQL, external integrations and hub listing
# stay disabled. Child control credentials are generated by the supervisor.
$include comms.txt
FORBID_STATION_TRAITS
GITHUBURL https://github.com/scolastico/babylon13
# Babylon is safe for work; the build also forces these on.
DISABLE_ERP_PREFERENCES
DISABLE_LEWD_ITEMS
# Upstream's game_options.txt/config.txt are not included, so their chat
# settings are set here. Without OOC_DURING_ROUND, OOC is muted at round start.
OOC_DURING_ROUND
EMOJIS
ALLOW_ADMIN_OOCCOLOR
ALLOW_ADMIN_ASAYCOLOR
# Game logs (say, OOC, admin actions, adminhelps ...), as upstream logs them.
$include logging.txt
